technical-summary: Added an owner-tracked native YAML inspection child using the existing captured-output planner path. It inherits only a sealed snapshot FD, changes cwd only in the child via a root FD, runs the absolute matched engine, bounds stdout/stderr, validates strict report identity and typed admission fields, and remains before durable power admission. Added positive and identity-mismatch CPU session cases.
user-summary-candidate: Added and verified the session-owner boundary for native YAML inspection, including sealed handoff, root handling, descriptor isolation, process journaling, and fail-closed report validation. The card-free session test passes; production YAML planner integration and actual engine invocation remain open.
